title: The Power of the Press
question: Does the writer think the parents were lucky or unlucky to gain prosperity in this way? Why?

meanings.usage: 及物动词，常接名词作宾语，常见搭配为restrict sb/sth to sth，表示“把某人/某物限制在某范围内”
及物动词，常用于正式语境中表示强烈反对某行为，常见搭配为condemn sb for (doing) sth
作“滥用”解时，宾语多为权力、权利等抽象名词；作“虐待”解时，宾语多为人或动物
表示“观点”时为可数名词，常用于正式辩论或论述语境；表示“争论”时为不可数名词
通常用于修饰抽象名词，强调程度或数量极大、难以衡量
及物动词，常见搭配为exert influence/pressure on sb/sth，表示“对某人/某物施加影响/压力”
及物动词，宾语通常为政府、政权、统治者等，过去式和过去分词为overthrew、overthrown
不可数名词，可指经济、事业等各方面的富足和成功

meanings.meaning: 永久的，不断的，无休止的
meanings.usage: 强调动作或状态持续发生、没有间断，常修饰抽象名词，带有一定负面色彩时表示“烦人的，没完没了的”
用于修饰动词或形容词，强调变化的程度非常大，完全改变原有状态
常用于表示权利、内容等仅供某一方使用，常见搭配为exclusive rights（独家权利）
作“无名”解时为不可数名词，常见搭配为live in obscurity（过着默默无闻的生活）
不可数名词，指将事物转化为以盈利为目的的商品的过程
可数名词，多指用于贸易的工农业产品，也可引申指被当作商品看待的人或事物

phrases.usage: 表示“根据……行事，按照……采取行动”，后接建议、观点、信息等名词作宾语

examples.en: Acting on the contention that facts are sacred, reporters can cause untold suffering to individuals.
examples.zh: 记者们遵从“事实至上”的观点，却可能给个人带来难以估量的痛苦。

examples.en: You should act on your teacher's advice if you want to improve your grades quickly.
examples.zh: 如果你想快速提高成绩，就应该按照老师的建议去做。

phrases.usage: 表示“导致，引起，使发生”，为及物短语动词，宾语通常为变化、问题、后果等名词

examples.en: Newspapers can not only bring about major changes to the lives of ordinary people but can even overthrow a government.
examples.zh: 报纸不仅能给普通人的生活带来重大改变，甚至能推翻一个政府。

examples.en: Technological advances have brought about great changes to the way we communicate.
examples.zh: 技术进步给我们的沟通方式带来了巨大的变化。

phrases.usage: 表示“面临，面对”，主语通常为人或组织，后接困难、问题、挑战等名词作宾语

examples.en: They were expecting their sixth child and were faced with even more pressing economic problems.
examples.zh: 他们正等着第六个孩子出生，面临着更为严峻的经济问题。

examples.en: When you are faced with a difficult choice, try to stay calm and weigh all the options.
examples.zh: 当你面临艰难抉择时，尽量保持冷静，权衡所有选择。

phrases.usage: 表示“强烈要求，敦促”，后接要求得到的事物或行动作宾语，也可接press sb for sth表示“向某人索要某物/敦促某人做某事”

examples.en: Reporters kept pressing for interviews so lawyers had to be employed to act as spokesmen.
examples.zh: 记者们不断要求采访，所以这家人不得不聘请律师在新闻发布会上充当发言人。

examples.en: Environmental groups are pressing for stricter laws to reduce plastic waste.
examples.zh: 环保组织正在敦促出台更严格的法律来减少塑料垃圾。

phrases.usage: 表示“为……付出代价”，后接行为、事件等名词，强调因某件事而承受不好的后果

examples.en: While the five babies were still sleeping in oxygen tents, their parents were paying the price for fame.
examples.zh: 当五个婴儿还在医院育婴室的氧气帐里安睡时，他们的父母已经在为出名付出代价了。

examples.en: Many young people pay the price for staying up late frequently when they get older.
examples.zh: 很多年轻人年纪大了之后，会为经常熬夜付出代价。

phrases.usage: 表示“大量涌入，蜂拥而至”，主语通常为信件、礼物、信息等名词，强调数量多、速度快

examples.en: Gifts poured in not only from unknown people, but from baby food manufacturers as well.
examples.zh: 大量礼物涌来，不仅来自素不相识的人，还有婴儿食品制造商。

examples.en: After the star shared her donation story, messages of support poured in from all over the country.
examples.zh: 这位明星分享了她的捐赠故事后，支持的信息从全国各地蜂拥而至。

phrases.usage: 表示“与……作斗争，努力克服”，后接困难、逆境、疾病等名词，强调对抗的过程很艰难

examples.en: They would have continued to struggle against economic odds and would have lived in obscurity.
examples.zh: 他们本会继续和经济困难作斗争，过着默默无闻的生活。

examples.en: The local people have been struggling against the flood for three days to protect their homes.
examples.zh: 当地民众已经和洪水抗争了三天，以保护他们的家园。

sentences.en: In democratic countries any efforts to restrict the freedom of the press are rightly condemned.
sentences.zh: 在民主国家，任何限制新闻自由的努力都理应受到谴责。

sentences.en: However, this freedom can easily be abused.
sentences.zh: 然而，这种自由很容易被滥用。

sentences.en: Stories about people often attract far more public attention than political events.
sentences.zh: 关于人物的故事常常比政治事件更能吸引公众的注意力。

sentences.en: Though we may enjoy reading about the lives of others,
sentences.zh: 尽管我们可能喜欢阅读别人的生活故事，

sentences.en: it is extremely doubtful whether we would equally enjoy reading about ourselves.
sentences.zh: 但我们是否同样喜欢阅读关于我们自己的故事，这一点是极度怀疑的。

sentences.en: Acting on the contention that facts are sacred,
sentences.zh: 记者们秉持着“事实神圣不可侵犯”的论点，

sentences.en: reporters can cause untold suffering to individuals by publishing details about their private lives.
sentences.zh: 通过刊登个人私生活的细节，给他们造成了无法言喻的痛苦。

sentences.en: Newspapers exert such tremendous influence that they can not only bring about major changes to the lives of ordinary people but can even overthrow a government.
sentences.zh: 报纸施加着巨大的影响力，它们不仅能给普通人的生活带来巨大变化，甚至可以推翻一个政府。

sentences.en: The story of a poor family that acquired fame and fortune overnight, dramatically illustrates the power of the press.
sentences.zh: 一个贫困家庭一夜之间获得名利的故事，戏剧性地说明了新闻界的力量。

sentences.en: The family lived in Aberdeen, a small town of 23,000 inhabitants in South Dakota.
sentences.zh: 这个家庭住在南达科他州一个拥有23,000居民的小镇阿伯丁。

sentences.en: As the parents had five children, life was a perpetual struggle against poverty.
sentences.zh: 由于这对父母有五个孩子，生活一直是与贫困的无休止的斗争。

sentences.en: They were expecting their sixth child and were faced with even more pressing economic problems.
sentences.zh: 他们正期待着第六个孩子，面临着更加紧迫的经济问题。

sentences.en: If they had only had one more child, the fact would have passed unnoticed.
sentences.zh: 如果他们只多生一个孩子，这件事就会不为人知。

sentences.en: They would have continued to struggle against economic odds and would have lived in obscurity.
sentences.zh: 他们会继续在经济困境中挣扎，并默默无闻地生活。

sentences.en: But they suddenly became the parents of quintuplets, four girls and a boy, an event which radically changed their lives.
sentences.zh: 但他们突然成了五胞胎的父母，四个女孩和一个男孩，这一事件彻底改变了他们的生活。

sentences.en: The day after the birth of the five children, an aeroplane arrived in Aberdeen bringing sixty reporters and photographers.
sentences.zh: 孩子们出生后的第二天，一架飞机抵达阿伯丁，带来了六十名记者和摄影师。

sentences.en: The rise to fame was swift.
sentences.zh: 成名之路迅速。

sentences.en: Television cameras and newspapers carried the news to everyone in the country.
sentences.zh: 电视摄像机和报纸将这一消息传遍了全国各地。

sentences.en: Newspapers and magazines offered the family huge sums for the exclusive rights to publish stories and photographs.
sentences.zh: 报纸和杂志为独家刊登这些故事和照片的权利，向这个家庭提供了巨额报酬。

sentences.en: Gifts poured in not only from unknown people,
sentences.zh: 礼物源源不断地涌来，不仅来自陌生人，

sentences.en: but from baby food and soap manufacturers who wished to advertise their products.
sentences.zh: 也来自希望宣传产品的婴儿食品和肥皂制造商。

sentences.en: The old farmhouse the family lived in was to be replaced by a new $500, 000 home.
sentences.zh: 这家人住的老农舍将被一座价值50万美元的新房子取代。

sentences.en: Reporters kept pressing for interviews so lawyers had to be employed to act as spokesmen for the family at press conferences.
sentences.zh: 记者们不停地要求采访，所以不得不雇佣律师在新闻发布会上担任这个家庭的发言人。

sentences.en: While the five babies were still quietly sleeping in oxygen tents in a hospital nursery,
sentences.zh: 当五个婴儿还在医院育婴室的氧气帐篷里安静地睡觉时，

sentences.en: their parents were paying the price for fame.
sentences.zh: 他们的父母却在为名声付出代价。

sentences.en: It would never again be possible for them to lead normal lives.
sentences.zh: 他们再也无法过上正常的生活了。

sentences.en: They had become the victims of commercialization, for their names had acquired a market value.
sentences.zh: 他们成了商业化的受害者，因为他们的名字已经有了市场价值。

sentences.en: Instead of being five new family members, these children had immediately become a commodity.
sentences.zh: 这些孩子不再是五个新的家庭成员，而是立刻变成了商品。

exercises.prompt: “无名，默默无闻；晦涩” 对应的单词是？
exercises.explain: obscurity · /əbˈskjʊərəti/ · noun · 无名，默默无闻；晦涩。作“无名”解时为不可数名词，常见搭配为live in obscurity（过着默默无闻的生活）

exercises.prompt: 根据释义和音标拼写单词：谴责，指责
exercises.explain: condemn · /kənˈdem/ · verb · 谴责，指责。及物动词，常用于正式语境中表示强烈反对某行为，常见搭配为condemn sb for (doing) sth

exercises.prompt: 补全短语：They would have continued to _____ economic odds and would have lived in obscurity.
exercises.hint: 他们本会继续和经济困难作斗争，过着默默无闻的生活。
exercises.explain: struggle against：表示“与……作斗争，努力克服”，后接困难、逆境、疾病等名词，强调对抗的过程很艰难（他们本会继续和经济困难作斗争，过着默默无闻的生活。）

exercises.prompt: 补全句子：But they _____ became the parents of quintuplets, four girls and a boy, an event which radically changed their lives.
exercises.hint: 但他们突然成了五胞胎的父母，四个女孩和一个男孩，这一事件彻底改变了他们的生活。
exercises.explain: But they suddenly became the parents of quintuplets, four girls and a boy, an event which radically changed their lives. — 但他们突然成了五胞胎的父母，四个女孩和一个男孩，这一事件彻底改变了他们的生活。

source.en: But they suddenly became the parents of quintuplets, four girls and a boy, an event which radically changed their lives.

exercises.prompt: “用于描述与过去实际发生的情况相反的假设，表达遗憾、假设等含义，主从句都针对过去的时间” 描述的是哪个语法点？
exercises.hint: If + 主语 + had + 过去分词, 主语 + would/could/might + have + 过去分词
options: It is + not uncommon / not unusual to... (it作形式主语)
与过去事实相反的虚拟语气
exercises.explain: 与过去事实相反的虚拟语气：If + 主语 + had + 过去分词, 主语 + would/could/might + have + 过去分词：从句描述假设的过去情况，主句描述该假设下会产生的过去结果，if可省略，此时将had提前至句首形成倒装

source.title: 与过去事实相反的虚拟语气

exercises.prompt:
选出下面句子的正确中文意思：
Television cameras and newspapers carried the news to everyone in the country.
options: 电视摄像机和报纸将这一消息传遍了全国各地。
贝茜为哈里特姑妈工作了三年。
这些就是所谓的“大型机”。
exercises.explain: Television cameras and newspapers carried the news to everyone in the country. — 电视摄像机和报纸将这一消息传遍了全国各地。

source.en: Television cameras and newspapers carried the news to everyone in the country.

grammar.title: 与过去事实相反的虚拟语气
grammar.definition: 用于描述与过去实际发生的情况相反的假设，表达遗憾、假设等含义，主从句都针对过去的时间
grammar.structure: If + 主语 + had + 过去分词, 主语 + would/could/might + have + 过去分词
grammar.usage: 从句描述假设的过去情况，主句描述该假设下会产生的过去结果，if可省略，此时将had提前至句首形成倒装

examples.en: If they had only had one more child, the fact would have passed unnoticed.
examples.zh: 如果他们只是多生了一个孩子，这件事本来根本不会有人注意。

examples.en: If I had studied harder last semester, I would have got a better score in the final exam.
examples.zh: 如果我上学期更努力学习，我期末考试就会考得更好。

grammar.title: such...that... 结果状语从句
grammar.definition: 用于表示“如此……以至于……”，引导结果状语从句，强调名词的程度或性质导致了某结果
grammar.structure: such + (a/an) + 形容词 + 可数名词单数/不可数名词/可数名词复数 + that + 结果从句
grammar.usage: such修饰其后的名词，当名词前有many/much/few/little修饰时，需用so代替such

examples.en: Newspapers exert such tremendous influence that they can not only bring about major changes to the lives of ordinary people but can even overthrow a government.
examples.zh: 报纸的影响力如此巨大，以至于它们不仅能给普通人的生活带来重大改变，甚至能推翻一个政府。

examples.en: It was such a boring speech that most of the audience fell asleep halfway through.
examples.zh: 这场演讲太无聊了，以至于大部分听众中途都睡着了。

original.en: Though we may enjoy reading about the lives of others, it is extremely doubtful whether we would equally enjoy reading about ourselves.
original.zh: 尽管我们可能喜欢读别人的生活故事，但我们是否同样喜欢读自己的故事，这一点非常值得怀疑。

examples.en: Though many people dream of being famous, it is extremely doubtful whether they can bear the pressure that comes with it.
examples.zh: 尽管很多人梦想出名，但他们是否能承受出名带来的压力非常值得怀疑。

examples.en: Though the plan sounds perfect in theory, it is extremely doubtful whether it can be carried out in practice.
examples.zh: 尽管这个计划理论上听起来很完美，但它在实践中是否能执行非常值得怀疑。

patterns.pattern: The story of... dramatically illustrates the power of...

original.en: The story of a poor family that acquired fame and fortune overnight, dramatically illustrates the power of the press.
original.zh: 一个贫苦家庭一夜之间名利双收的故事，生动地说明了新闻界的力量。

examples.en: The story of the small business that grew into a global company in ten years dramatically illustrates the power of innovation.
examples.zh: 这个小企业十年内成长为跨国公司的故事，生动地说明了创新的力量。

examples.en: The story of the disabled athlete who won the gold medal dramatically illustrates the power of persistence.
examples.zh: 这位残疾运动员赢得金牌的故事，生动地说明了坚持的力量。

patterns.pattern: Instead of being..., ... had immediately become...

original.en: Instead of being five new family members, these children had immediately become a commodity.
original.zh: 这些孩子非但没有成为五名新的家庭成员，反而立刻变成了一种商品。

examples.en: Instead of being a tool to improve learning efficiency, the mobile phone has immediately become a distraction for many students.
examples.zh: 手机非但没有成为提升学习效率的工具，反而立刻变成了很多学生分心的事物。

examples.en: Instead of being a place for relaxation, the crowded scenic spot had immediately become a source of stress for the tourists.
examples.zh: 这个拥挤的景区非但没有成为放松的地方，反而立刻变成了游客压力的来源。
